verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of choosing a regional workspace or residency location for data Segment stores. The Data Storage Destinations (warehouses, S3, GCS) send copies of data to downstream tools, which is an adjacent feature, not region selection for Segment's own storage. Privacy Portal and consent docs concern compliance and consent, not residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
